identity.title: LER 2020-004-00 for Turkey Point Unit 3 re Manual Reactor Trip in Response to Automatic Trip of the 3B Steam Generator Feedwater Pump

cause.proximate_text: The SGFP Recirculation Valve Master Controller, from where the positions of the recirculation valves are demanded, was in Manual, but should have been in Automatic mode to properly position CV-3-1414. ... the SGFP Recirculation Valve Master Controller had reverted to Manual mode, as designed, following a Unit 3 manual reactor trip that had occurred 3 days prior. The root cause and factors involved in the delayed recognition of the SGFP Valve Master Controller mode of operation are currently being evaluated on AR 2366158.

nodes.display_name: Master Controller reverted to Manual mode following prior reactor trip
nodes.description: The SGFP Recirculation Valve Master Controller reverted to Manual mode, as designed, following a Unit 3 manual reactor trip 3 days prior, and this was not recognized.

nodes.display_name: CV-3-1414 left open due to Manual-mode demand
nodes.description: With the Master Controller in Manual instead of Automatic, CV-3-1414 remained open when operating conditions required it closed, causing near run-out conditions on the 3B SGFP.
Reactor Operator closed CV-3-1414 after discovering the Master Controller was in Manual instead of Automatic, causing a pressure fluctuation.

nodes.display_name: Low suction pressure below 225 psig setpoint
nodes.description: Pressure fluctuation from closing CV-3-1414 caused suction pressure to drop below the 225 psig setpoint.
The 3B SGFP automatically tripped in response to the low suction pressure condition.
